decisions.reason: The decision changes only the interboard power connector pin order; the I2C cable, clock, pull-up resistance, and pull-up location remain unchanged.
Allowing a layout-suitable electrical pin order does not change the board dimensions, orientation, connector placement, spacing, or mounting-hole constraints.
The charge-status indicator, GPIO, and separate-LED policy are unaffected by the interboard power connector pin order.
This Requirement concerns the battery JST interface, while the source decision concerns the separate power-board-to-main-board power connector.
The switched 5V boost behavior and enable configuration remain unchanged; only the physical order of interboard power connector signals is made layout-dependent.
Battery protection modes and cutoff values are unrelated to the interboard power connector pin-order policy.
The source decision does not change the USB-C connector type, data-line requirement, or sourceability constraints.
Choosing the interboard power connector pin order to suit layout does not change the required eight-layer stack.
Battery temperature sensing through the J_BAT NTC connection is unaffected by the separate interboard power connector pin order.
The source decision does not alter the requirement for TVS-based ESD protection.
The pin-order decision does not select or replace a component and does not change any availability or sourcing constraint.
